snippet.title: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Launch Gameplay Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Pre-Purchase Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 and receive access to the Foundry Demo - available now! 

https://www.xbox.com/games/tony-hawks-pro-skater-3-4

Shred across Foundry and College parks as Tony Hawk or Rayssa Leal, alongside a selection of eardrum shattering songs. Digital Deluxe Edition purchasers will also get to skate as The Doom Slayer. 

Demo Includes: 
- 2 playable Skaters 
- 2 playable Parks 
- Limited In-Game Soundtrack 
- The Doom Slayer playable skater (Digital Deluxe Edition only)    

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
